body:
SERVER READINESS vs THE ROADMAP (lead, 26 Nov 2026; the status column of docs/36 section 8, which is a truth document and keeps no status). Checked on main 72048b0 + the P3-31 branch.
READY: a place for a new module (routes/<area>.py since P3-31 + the add-on manifest of docs/35); the server's identity key (signed in GET info); the live channel (Jam will need rooms on top); one kept DB connection (ADR-R45, fine for 1 to 20 people); a version handshake (apiVersion, minAppVersion in GET info); a route inventory that cannot drift (tests/test_route_table.py, P3-31).
MISSING, each with the item that closes it:
1. NO DOWNGRADE GUARD (P3-29 part 2, never built): db.migrate() ignores migration numbers it does not know, so an older image started on a newer database runs and misreads it. This must exist BEFORE the Update button and any rollback image (P3-14, P3-25). Small, server only, the next server item after P3-30 unless the owner says otherwise.
2. NO BROWSER SESSION, NO STATIC SERVING, NO CSP (slice 1 of P3-06, decided in docs/36 section 2: the device token in sessionStorage, no cookies, a 'browser' session kind of 12 h idle / 7 days).
3. NO HOST SETTINGS STORE (slice 3: the typed host_setting table + the add-on manifest). The existing `setting` table holds the identity PRIVATE key and the song-signing secret: no route may ever read it.
4. NO HEALTH ROUTE, NO JOB RECORD (slices 4 and 6).
5. NO SETUP CODE in the code (it is on paper only, 15 section 1): the wizard must not exist before it.
6. NO PASSWORD KEY AT INSTALL and a backup that holds secrets in the clear (P3-30, next).
7. THE COMPOSE FILE FOLLOWS THE TAG `main` (ENCORE_TAG default): every server follows every merge (P3-27) - the Update button must call a release channel.
8. THE IMAGE IS amd64 ONLY (P3-17, later; the appliance is amd64 first).
9. install.sh MAKES THE OWNER ITSELF (setup.py on stdin): docs/36 section 2 moves that to the browser for both doors, keeping --owner for headless installs; this changes install.sh, install-test.md and the walked proofs c01, c03, c06 (P3-07 walks both doors again).
DECIDED IN docs/36 (advisor, 26 Nov): the helper runs ON THE COMPUTER (systemd socket + the encore command's own subcommands), because `encore funnel on` installs and drives the computer's own Tailscale and install.sh already needs Debian/Ubuntu + systemd; no Docker socket in any container (P3-04 stays literally true). A container-with-docker.sock option was weighed and rejected (it could not do the Tailscale part without a second way out).
